Hi Marissa,

As we approach our renewal, the exec team at Clearline would prefer to combine the renewal QBR with your roadmap/demo into a single, time-boxed session rather than two separate meetings. Our constraint: leadership can only free up 90 minutes on June 9 or a 60-minute slot on June 10 (APAC folks in APAC will need a recorded session).

Can you propose a compact agenda and two concrete time windows that work for your team? Also let us know if you need any pre-reads or security artifacts in advance.

Thanks — Alex

Alex — thanks for the note and the attendee list. We can absolutely run a combined session; I do want to keep it tight so it's useful for both execs and engineers. Two options below (both in PDT):

Option A — 90 min (preferred for live Q&A + technical breakout)
- June 9, 10:00–11:30 AM PDT
- Run: 20m renewal highlights + 40m product roadmap/demo (live) + 20m technical deep-dive/Q&A + 10m next steps

Option B — 60 min (recorded-friendly)
- June 10, 1:00–2:00 PM PDT
- Run: 25m combined highlights + 25m demo (tight) + 10m next steps. We would record the session and provide a 15m technical walk-through pre-recorded clip for APAC.

I attached a very short proposed agenda (Clearline_proposed_agenda.pdf). A few notes:
- If you want a true technical breakout (live), we need Laura to lead and have at least 30 minutes for it — so Option A is better for that ask.
- We recommend a 30-minute staging call with engineers for Option A the morning of (to warm caches, test integrations, and ensure Model/quantization variants are set for demo requests).
- Security artifacts: we can share SOC2 summary and API connectivity docs ahead of time — Priyom, can you handle that?

If either slot works, I can send a calendar invite and run-of-show.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
